---
title: "Parameter Estimates (SD Scale)"
format: html
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(DT)
```

```{r load-data}
res <- readRDS(here("results", "model_fits.rds"))

state_sts  <- res$state_sts
state_bfgs <- res$state_bfgs
state_kem  <- res$state_kem

# Sampling SDs — named vector with state abbreviations
samp_sd_vec <- dget(here("data", "sampling_error.txt"))
```

```{r mapping}
# State abbreviation to full lowercase name mapping
abbr_to_name <- c(
  AL = "alabama", AK = "alaska", AZ = "arizona", AR = "arkansas",
  CA = "california", CO = "colorado", CT = "connecticut", DE = "delaware",
  FL = "florida", GA = "georgia", HI = "hawaii", ID = "idaho",
  IL = "illinois", IN = "indiana", IA = "iowa", KS = "kansas",
  KY = "kentucky", LA = "louisiana", ME = "maine", MD = "maryland",
  MA = "massachusetts", MI = "michigan", MN = "minnesota", MS = "mississippi",
  MO = "missouri", MT = "montana", NE = "nebraska", NV = "nevada",
  NH = "new hampshire", NJ = "new jersey", NM = "new mexico", NY = "new york",
  NC = "north carolina", ND = "north dakota", OH = "ohio", OK = "oklahoma",
  OR = "oregon", PA = "pennsylvania", RI = "rhode island", SC = "south carolina",
  SD = "south dakota", TN = "tennessee", TX = "texas", UT = "utah",
  VT = "vermont", VA = "virginia", WA = "washington", WV = "west virginia",
  WI = "wisconsin", WY = "wyoming"
)

# Build a lookup from full state name -> sampling SD
# Only states present in samp_sd_vec get a value
samp_sd_lookup <- setNames(samp_sd_vec, abbr_to_name[names(samp_sd_vec)])
```

```{r build-table-function}
build_sd_table <- function(state_params, samp_sd_lookup) {
  # state_params: rows = (d, var_innov, var_obs), cols = state names
  tbl <- as.data.frame(t(state_params))
  colnames(tbl) <- c("drift", "var_innov", "var_obs")

  # Add sampling SD (NA for states not in the lookup, e.g. alaska, hawaii)
  tbl$sampling_SD <- samp_sd_lookup[rownames(tbl)]

  # Shock variance = observation variance - sampling variance
  tbl$shock_var <- tbl$var_obs - tbl$sampling_SD^2

  # Convert variances to SDs
  tbl$process_SD     <- sqrt(tbl$var_innov)
  tbl$observation_SD <- sqrt(tbl$var_obs)
  tbl$shock_SD       <- sqrt(ifelse(tbl$shock_var >= 0, tbl$shock_var, NA))

  # Select and order final columns
  out <- tbl[, c("drift", "process_SD", "observation_SD", "sampling_SD", "shock_SD")]

  out
}
```

## StructTS

```{r table-structts}
tbl_sts <- build_sd_table(state_sts, samp_sd_lookup)

DT::datatable(
  round(tbl_sts, 8),
  caption  = "StructTS parameter estimates (SD scale)",
  options  = list(pageLength = 50, scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = TRUE
)
```
